scope: Temperature low-ell morphology under homogeneous Bianchi I, isotropic sharp last scattering, collisionless propagation, comoving (untilted) emitters and observer. No E/B, no V/VIIh.

B_star_STF5.meaning: endpoint metric anisotropy B* at t*, symmetric trace-free, g_ij = a^2 [exp(2B)]_ij
B_star_STF5.relation_to_sigma_over_H: NOT identified here. B* is a history integral (-int sigma dt only for commuting fixed-axis history); it must not be placed in the 17D sigma/H slots without an explicit map.
B_star_STF5.sign_convention: g = a^2 exp(+2B); opposite convention requires B -> -B

parameters.T_bar: a* T*; degenerate with the observed monopole; treated as nuisance, NOT as a prediction

deterministic_template.ell_content: even ell <= 2k at order k in B*
deterministic_template.harmonic_coefficients: a_lm by exact quadrature (GL x uniform phi); validated against HEALPix anafast C_l
deterministic_template.monopole: physical monopole shift -(2/15) tr B*^2 + (4/315) tr B*^3 is absorbed by T_bar; a_00 versus physical monopole bookkeeping is a replay obligation from WU-011 Task 5A, NOT_RUN here

stochastic_covariance.reference: statistically isotropic Gaussian C_M(psi), declared phenomenological/background-only approximation
stochastic_covariance.anisotropic_extension: BipoSH A^{LM}_{ll'} with X,Y in {T,E,B} only where data and transfer support those channels

separation_rule.rule: L1.T (mean) and L1.C (covariance) are separate likelihood components. They may be combined only inside ONE generative model whose mean and covariance derive from the same parameters; otherwise the two readouts use the same data twice and their log-likelihoods must not be added.

data_model.covariance: Sigma_d = R C_M R^T + N_inst + C_fg + C_sys
data_model.likelihood: Gaussian with full Sigma_d; log|Sigma_d| retained when parameters enter Sigma_d
data_model.phase_data_required: C_ell summaries cannot substitute for phase-sensitive a_lm data
